issues.description: The template's Main.java uses a method call farm.feed(), whereas the problem specification and the solution use feedAllAnimals(). This mismatch in the expected Farm method name can confuse students about which method to implement and may lead them to implement the wrong method name or miss the required feedAllAnimals() method.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals() (matching the specification and solution), or modify the Farm template to include a feed() method that delegates to feedAllAnimals(). This ensures the template examples align with the required Farm API and prevents student confusion.

issues.description: The problem specification and the solution use the method name feedAllAnimals() for the Farm operation that calls messageOnFeed() on all animals, but the template's Main.java calls farm.feed(). This inconsistent naming of the same conceptual operation (feeding all animals on the farm) can confuse students: they may look for feed() in the Farm stub and not find it, or implement the method under the wrong name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template consistent with the problem and solution by changing the call in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java from farm.feed() to farm.feedAllAnimals(), or add a feed() method in the Farm stub that delegates to feedAllAnimals() to preserve the intended API.
